title: General Authority of Islamic Affairs, Endowments and Zakat — Open Data
description: Extracted and structured datasets from the UAE General Authority of Islamic Affairs, Endowments and Zakat (GAIAEZ). Each folder contains a glossary.json (metadata, field definitions, dictionary terms), per-year JSON files with the full nested data, and an all_records.json with flattened records optimized for vector store ingestion.
source_organization: General Authority of Islamic Affairs, Endowments and Zakat (الهيئة العامة للشؤون الإسلامية والأوقاف والزكاة)

datasets.original_name: Statistics On Occupancy Rates and Revenues for Real Estate Endowments at the State Level For
datasets.dataset_name: Statistics On Occupancy Rates and Revenues for Real Estate Endowments at the State Level
datasets.purpose: Tracks the monthly occupancy rates and rental revenues collected from the Authority's real estate endowment properties (residential, commercial, and industrial units) across all emirates except Abu Dhabi.
datasets.coverage: All Emirates except Abu Dhabi (Dubai, Sharjah, Ajman, Umm Al Quwain, Ras Al Khaimah, Fujairah)

datasets.original_name: Monthly Statistics for Hajj Package Service
datasets.dataset_name: Monthly Statistics for Hajj Package Service
datasets.department: Hajj and Umrah Affairs — Pilgrims and Umrah Performers Department
datasets.purpose: Counts monthly transactions for the Hajj permit service (registration, screening, medical examination, and permit issuance) broken down by service delivery channel (website vs smart application), and tracks the number of Hajj package recipients.

datasets.original_name: List of approved Hajj and Umrah campaigns
datasets.dataset_name: List of Approved Hajj and Umrah Campaigns
datasets.purpose: A directory/registry of all licensed Hajj and Umrah campaign companies in the UAE, including their registration details, contact information, emirate, activity type (Hajj and Umrah vs Umrah only), and branch locations.

datasets.original_name: Statistics on student registration in the Holy Quran education service
datasets.dataset_name: Statistics on Student Registration in the Holy Quran Education Service
datasets.purpose: Tracks monthly student registration transactions for the Holy Quran education service, broken down by service delivery channel (website vs smart application).

datasets.original_name: General Authority for Islamic Affairs, Endowments and Zakat Centers for Quran Memorization
datasets.purpose: A directory of all Quran memorization centers operated or overseen by the Authority, including center name, branch/emirate, area, center type (Government, Endowment/Waqf, Private, Rented), and geographic coordinates. Years 2021-2022 use a legacy format with English names, year established, and student gender but no coordinates.

datasets.original_name: Statistics on Quran memorization circles and their students for the year
datasets.purpose: A directory of mosques hosting Quran memorization circles (halaqat), including the mosque name, branch/city, area, number of memorization circles per mosque, and geographic coordinates.

datasets.original_name: Zakat Payment Service Statistics
datasets.purpose: Tracks monthly Zakat fund collection statistics across all payment channels (bank transfers, mobile apps, ATMs, kiosks, electronic payments, direct payers, etc.), recording both the number of payers and the total funds collected per channel. Aligned with SDG 1 (No Poverty) and SDG 8 (Decent Work and Economic Growth).

datasets.original_name: Key Outcomes of Zakat Disbursement
datasets.purpose: Tracks monthly Zakat disbursement outcomes across beneficiary project categories (orphans' families, widows, people of determination, low income, divorcees, patients, new Muslims, job seekers, debtors, senior citizens, disaster victims, etc.), recording the number of eligible families served and the total expenditures per project.

datasets.original_name: Statistics of Petition Request Service
datasets.purpose: Tracks monthly petition request volumes by service delivery channel (iPad, smartphone app, website, in-person service center, mobile website), providing insight into how customers interact with the Authority's petition services.

datasets.original_name: Statistics of a Certificate To Whom It May Concern for Obtaining Zakat Assistance Service
datasets.dataset_name: Certificate "To Whom It May Concern" for Zakat Assistance
datasets.purpose: Tracks monthly request volumes for the "To Whom It May Concern" certificate used to obtain Zakat assistance, broken down by service delivery channel (smartphone app, chatbot, website, Good Loan project, call center, in-person service center, mobile website).

datasets.original_name: Zakat Calculation Service Statistics
datasets.purpose: Tracks monthly Zakat calculation request volumes by service delivery channel (website, smartphone app, mobile website, Zaki WhatsApp platform, call center, in-person service center). Earlier years (2022-2023) include additional channels like IVR, SMS, fax, email, and live chat.

datasets.original_name: Monthly Statistics for Hajj Permit Service
datasets.dataset_name: Monthly Statistics for Hajj Permit Service
datasets.purpose: Tracks monthly Hajj permit transactions by service delivery channel (website, smart application) and the number of Hajj package recipients.

datasets.original_name: Monthly data for Hajj and Umrah workers' permits service
datasets.dataset_name: Monthly Statistics for Hajj and Umrah Workers Permits Service
datasets.purpose: Tracks monthly transactions for the Hajj and Umrah workers' permits service by channel (website, smart application).

datasets.original_name: Monthly data for renewed Hajj and Umrah campaigns Service
datasets.dataset_name: Monthly Statistics for Hajj and Umrah Campaigns Renewal Service
datasets.purpose: Tracks monthly transactions for the Hajj and Umrah campaign renewal service by channel (website, smart application).

datasets.original_name: Monthly data for Teaching the Holy Quran service
datasets.dataset_name: Monthly Statistics for Teaching the Holy Quran Service
datasets.purpose: Tracks monthly transactions for the Holy Quran teaching service by channel (website, smart application). Distinct from the student registration dataset.

datasets.original_name: Data on the smart platform for teaching the Qur'an for the year 2020
datasets.purpose: Demographics of learners enrolled in the smart platform for remote Quran teaching, broken down by country of origin, gender (male/female), and age group (6-10, 11-20, 21-30, 31-50, 50+). Covers learners from over 100 countries.

datasets.original_name: Detailed data of mosques / Mosques data list
datasets.purpose: A comprehensive directory of mosques across the UAE, including name, number, branch/emirate, area, and mosque type (Friday/Jumu'ah or Congregation/Jama'ah). The 2023 dataset additionally includes geographic coordinates.

datasets.original_name: 2021-Umrah campaigns data
datasets.purpose: Historical directory of Umrah-only campaign companies approved in the UAE from 2011 to 2021, including campaign name, owner, registration number, emirate, and contact details.

datasets.original_name: Phone numbers / Names / Statistics of Holy Quran memorization centers
datasets.purpose: Three supplementary directories of Quran memorization centers: phone numbers (2020-2021), center names with phone numbers, and a centers list with new-center annotations. Provides additional contact and classification data beyond the main centers dataset.

datasets.original_name: The names of mosques for memorizing the Holy Quran
datasets.purpose: A directory of mosques hosting Quran memorization circles (halaqat), organized by emirate. Each entry includes the mosque name, region, student gender, and number of circles per mosque.
